name: plan
description: 读取已确认的 spec.md，基于 plan_template.md 做技术决策，生成 plan.md。必须给出 spec 中每个 Open Question 一个唯一确定答案；用户确认后方可进入 Test-Planning。

prompt.instruction: Read spec.md and translate every functional requirement into a technical decision: architecture shape, key schema, communication mechanism, file layout, library choices, risk + mitigation. Each section of plan_template.md must be filled with concrete answers. Append a 'Spec Open Questions resolution' table that lists every Q-N from spec and the corresponding section in this plan that resolves it.
guardrails: Every spec Open Question must have exactly one definitive answer in this plan.
For each major decision, write its trade-off briefly so future readers understand why it was chosen.
Do not write executable code; describe schemas, interfaces, and algorithms only.
Reference spec FR IDs verbatim when describing what a decision implements.
